svg.title: How WiCare sees a fall without a camera
svg.desc: A top-down view of a hospital room. Wi-Fi waves spread from an access point to two ESP32 sensors, and some signal paths pass through the patient in bed. When the patient falls to the floor, those paths change, the 52 subcarrier readings jump and then settle into a new pattern, and the motion score shows a short burst followed by 8 seconds of stillness, which raises a possible fall alert and texts the nurse.
svg.text: How WiCare sees a fall without a camera
Each line is a path the Wi-Fi signal takes. A body changes them.
What the sensors read: 52 Wi-Fi subcarriers
